description:
The Hokkaido International Foundation (HIF) offers a scholarship for foreign students of Japanese to attend its intensive summer Japanese-language programme in Hakodate. The annual call, including the deadline and grant coverage, is published on the foundation's scholarship page for foreigners.

Programme Highlights

  • Long-running intensive Japanese summer programme in Hokkaido
  • Scholarship support for international learners of Japanese
  • Immersion format with homestay options
  • Annual call with a fixed deadline announced each year

Who Should Apply

University students and recent learners of Japanese worldwide with basic proficiency and strong motivation for language study.

Funding and Costs

Grant covering programme fees and/or living support for the Japanese-language summer course, per the foundation's conditions. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the HIF scholarship page for the current call and submit the application packet by the announced deadline. Key deadline information: Annual call for the summer programme — the deadline is announced on the foundation's scholarship page.
